items.reader: The readout recommends not shipping v7. It raises SSR on triggered searches (+0.0078 absolute), but scaled to all searches the lift is about +0.0008 absolute, well below the +0.005 bar. The run was clean: planned 14 days, balance check passed, no mid-run changes. Guardrails are within margin. Don't ship. Choose between stopping, or recording an explicit waiver or redefinition of the bar as a deviation. Waiving looks hard to justify, since even the CI upper bound (~+0.0011) is far under +0.005. The only route that could reach the bar is widening the trigger and rerunning, which needs its own pre-registration. Overall SSR lift, +0.0008 absolute (about +0.39% relative), against a bar of +0.005 absolute. I re-derived it from the doc's figures (0.10 × 0.0078 ≈ 0.00078, CI ≈ ±0.00025) and it checks out. The headline +1.9% applies only to the 10% of searches that trigger, so it overstates the launch-level effect. The doc also flags about 70 uncorrected metric and segment reads, so the Queries per User drop (−1.0%, p=0.024) could be chance. It treats that as chance, not harm.
